svg.title: NSF Engines pipeline: boundaries, steps, decisions and limits
svg.desc: A boundary box lists the scope and sources; eight steps run top to bottom, each with the key decision taken and the main limitation.

g.text: 12 Engines of Cohort 2 · window: 5 years before the award, onward
Sources: NSF API, Engine sites, OpenAlex, ROR, USPTO + PatentsView
Limit: names and e-mail domains only

svg.text: Team pages curated by hand, URL per row

g.text: Limit: merged or split author profiles
Limit: 4 Engines show partners as logos only
Limit: topics and CPC need human review
Limit: state proxy; no pre-grant publications

svg.text: Patent LQ vs US; partner share of patents

g.text: Limit: partner subsidiaries not yet matched

svg.text: One Rmd template → 12 pages on GitHub

g.text: Limit: numbers, not judgement — text is yours

svg.text: Teal: steps · gray: decision taken · coral: main limitation
